messages:
Marta Lopez: blue sunday thought — if a record were a character, which album would star in a melancholy novel? ill kick it off: Joni Mitchell — Blue as an ageing protagonist.
Dev Singh: Leonard Cohen — Songs of Love and Hate = the grizzled mentor. reads like a last-chapter reveal.
Priya Rao: Kate Bush — Hounds of Love = the magical realist heroine. weird, catalytic, unreadably kind.
Ben Torres: Poll: do you prefer album-as-character or book-as-soundtrack? react with :one: for album, :two: for book.
Tally (poll-bot): Poll created (24h): "Album as character vs Book as soundtrack" — options: 1) Album-as-character, 2) Book-as-soundtrack.
Marta Lopez: Also adding a weird hybrid pick: Sufjan Stevens — Illinois as a small-town antihero. makes me want to reread Gilead.
Dev Singh: Spotty playlist to follow. dropping a tiny seed: https://open.spotify.com/album/1uTNm9J6rQvY0dgYq4cM2p
Priya Rao: Ha! My rec is arvo pärt for interior monologue. slow music that reads like punctuation.
Ben Torres: Quick two-line challenge: name one album and one book you would put in a care package for someone moving cities. Ill go first: Arcade Fire — Funeral + The Lonely City by Olivia Laing.
Marta Lopez: @Ben thats perfect. my care package: Gillian Welch — Time (EP) + The Shipping News.
Spotty (spotify-bot): ```
shared_seed: 7y8h3k_playlist_seed
tracks_added: 14
created_by: Spotty (spotify-bot)
```
Dev Singh: results so far on the poll look close. surprised people are split.
Priya Rao: we should actually do a real "album-book swap" thread next weekend — people post one album and one book in a thread, then someone else curates a 10-song playlist from those.
Marta Lopez: yes please. mini community culture idea. tagging this as "post-weekend activity" in my brain :brain:
Ben Torres: :thumbsup: Im in. also sending a DM to @Priya with a weird mixtape idea.
Tally (poll-bot): Poll update: Album-as-character 8 votes, Book-as-soundtrack 6 votes (12 total).
Marta Lopez: wrap-up: thanks folks. putting these on my weekend queue. good night and dream in album covers :crescent_moon:
